name: Shapeshifter: Endless Run
summary: Shapeshifter is a fast-paced endless runner set in a mystical forest. The core mechanic involves transforming between five different animals—wolf, moose, rabbit, raven, and bear—each with unique abilities to overcome specific terrain obstacles. Players must switch forms in real-time to outrun a forest guardian, collect coins for cosmetic skins, and navigate changing environmental hazards across global leaderboards.
